short-description: Ralph’s Bar & Bowling is a Catskills time capsule with two old-school lanes, a full bar, pool table, dancing, and very little reason to call it an early night.
long-description: Ralph’s Bar & Bowling is a Catskills time machine with two lanes of old-school bowling, a full bar, pool table, dancing, and plenty of reasons to stay awhile. Open to everyone, Ralph’s is the Lodge’s neighborhood hangout for Cowboy Cocktails, cold beer, hot dogs, brats, pretzels, and weekend pizza from Auggie’s Tiny Pizza Kitchen. No reservations. Just show up, grab a drink, and step back in time
name: Ralph’s Bar & Bowling

short-description: Every great lodge needs a good bar. The Parlor Bar is ours. Settle with great cocktails, a seasonal drink list, a fire nearby, and just enough swagger to keep the night from getting too civilized.
long-description: Every great lodge needs a good bar. The Parlor Bar is ours. Settle in for some of the best cocktails around, a rotating drink menu inspired by the season, and casual service that makes you feel right at home. Settle in for a pre-dinner cocktail, a slow evening by the fire, or one more round before calling it a night.
name: Parlor Bar

short-description: Seasonal Catskills fare made with ingredients from local growers and makers, balancing familiar flavors with a little polish and just enough reason to linger over dinner.
long-description: The Dining Room serves seasonal fare with ingredients sourced from local makers and growers. It’s thoughtful, familiar, and quietly elevated — the kind of meal that feels special without trying too hard. Reservations are recommended for The Dining Room.
name: The Dining Room
